pack.name: Neonfall
pack.description: Rain never stops in Vesper Arc. A ghost of the Lattice, a chrome gang boss and a corporate security chief fight for the drowned megacity in 60 original cards.

GUARD.name: Firewall
GUARD.tip: Enemies must attack minions with Firewall first.

HASTE.name: Overclock
HASTE.tip: Can attack the turn it is played.

BARRIER.name: Hardlight
BARRIER.tip: The first time it would take damage, it takes none and loses Hardlight.

STEALTH.name: Cloak
STEALTH.tip: Can't be attacked or targeted until it attacks.

SPELLPROOF.name: Encrypted
SPELLPROOF.tip: Can't be targeted by spells or Champion Powers.

ON_PLAY.name: Boot
ON_PLAY.tip: Does something when you play it from your hand.

WOUNDED.name: Redline
WOUNDED.tip: Has an extra effect while damaged.

COMBO.name: Chain
COMBO.tip: A bonus if you already played a card this turn.

MANA_LOCK.name: Heat
MANA_LOCK.tip: Heat (X): you have X less Mana next turn.

TRAP.name: Protocol
TRAP.tip: Hidden until it triggers on your opponent's turn.

SILENCE.name: Wipe
SILENCE.tip: Removes all card text and enchantments from a minion.

FREEZE.name: Jam
FREEZE.tip: A Jammed character misses its next attack.

SPELL_POWER.name: Bandwidth
SPELL_POWER.tip: Your spells deal X more damage.

ARMOR.tip: Absorbs damage to your champion before Health.

FATIGUE.name: Data Rot
FATIGUE.tip: Drawing from an empty deck deals growing damage to your champion.

1.intro: Play minions and send them at Brick. Bring his Health down to 0 and you're in!

lines.start: You're not on the list, lady. Walk away.
lines.defeat: Okay, okay... you're on the list.

1.reward_line: Every door needs a good wall.

2.intro: Spend all your Mana every turn and make Sharkey pay up!

lines.start: Iris Null! Your tab is overdue, sweetheart. With interest.
lines.hurt: Ow! That's coming out of your deposit!

2.reward_line: A hole nobody has patched yet.

3.intro: When minions fight each other, both take damage. Pick your fights!

lines.start: Sunvault's top dog, down in the Undertow? Catch me if you can.
lines.hurt: Hounds, cover me! I'm not paid enough for this.
lines.defeat: Fine, you caught me. Put it in your quarterly report.

4.intro: Don't understand a card? Hover over it to read its keywords!

lines.start: Mother Rust! That arm is overdue for an upgrade. Lie down.
lines.hurt: Hold still! I've only swapped half of you!
lines.defeat: Fascinating... Pain is just data, after all.

5.intro: Clear ARCHON's Drones before the wall grows!

6.intro: Director Vale plays a real deck. Hit him with Shakedown every turn!

lines.start: Mother Rust. Your visit has been logged, billed and denied.
lines.hurt: Noted. Damage to company assets will be charged to your account.
lines.defeat: Very well. I will schedule my resignation... for next quarter.

6.reward_line: The Undertow takes care of its own.

hints.play: Click a card in your hand to play it. Minions go on the board.
hints.attack: Click a minion that can attack, then click an enemy to attack it.
hints.end_turn: Nothing more to do? Press End Turn.
hints.mana: You get one more Mana crystal every turn. Spend it all!
hints.spell: Click a spell, then click the minion it should hit.
hints.jam: A Jammed minion misses its next attack.
hints.trade: Kill enemy minions before they become a problem!
hints.boot: A Boot effect happens when you play the card from your hand.
hints.flatline: A Flatline effect happens when the minion dies.
hints.tooltip: Hover over any card to read it and its keywords.
hints.firewall: Minions with Firewall must be attacked first. Play one to protect your champion!
hints.overclock: Minions with Overclock can attack at once. Heat takes some of your Mana next turn.
hints.cloak: A Cloaked minion can't be attacked until it attacks.
hints.power: Your Champion Power is next to your portrait. Use it once each turn!
hints.chain: Play another card first, then a Chain card for its bonus.
hints.wipe: Wipe a minion to strip its Firewall and all its text.
hints.plating: Plating protects your champion: damage hits it before Health.
hints.protocol: Director Vale's Protocols are hidden. They trigger on your turn.
hints.hardlight: Hardlight blocks the first damage. Break it with something small first.
hints.encrypted: Encrypted minions can't be targeted by spells or Champion Powers.

tutorial.minion_card.title: A minion card
tutorial.minion_card.text: Every card costs Mana to play. Minions also have Attack and Health.
tutorial.minion_card.cost: Mana cost: what it takes to play the card
tutorial.combat.title: Combat
tutorial.combat.text: When minions fight, each deals its Attack as damage to the other. A minion with 0 Health dies.
tutorial.champions.title: Champions
tutorial.champions.text: Your champion has 30 Health. Attack the enemy champion with your minions: bring it to 0 Health to win!
tutorial.mana.title: Mana
tutorial.mana.text: You get one more Mana crystal every turn, up to 10. Playing a card spends its cost. Try to spend all your Mana every turn!
tutorial.spells.title: Spells
tutorial.spells.text: A spell does its effect once and is gone. Many spells need a target: play the spell, then pick a minion. A Jammed character misses its next attack.
tutorial.spells.target: You pick the minion it hits
tutorial.boot.title: Boot
tutorial.boot.text: A Boot effect happens once, when you play the card from your hand.
tutorial.boot.jams: Boot: Jams an enemy minion when played
tutorial.flatline.title: Flatline
tutorial.flatline.text: A Flatline effect happens when the minion dies. Mira's crew leave things behind when they fall.
tutorial.flatline.shard: ...a Hound Shard comes to your hand!
tutorial.minions_first.title: Minions first
tutorial.minions_first.text: While Mira has minions, she can't be attacked. Damage stays on a minion until it is healed, so finish them off!
tutorial.firewall.title: Firewall
tutorial.firewall.text: Enemies must attack a minion with Firewall before anything else. Put one in front of your champion!
tutorial.overclock.title: Overclock and Heat
tutorial.overclock.text: A minion can't attack on the turn it is played. Minions with Overclock attack at once. Heat (X) is the price: next turn you have X less Mana.
tutorial.overclock.waits: Played this turn: has to wait
tutorial.overclock.at_once: Overclock: attacks at once. Heat (1): 1 less Mana next turn
tutorial.cloak.title: Cloak and Dual-Core
tutorial.cloak.text: A Cloaked minion can't be attacked or targeted until it attacks. Varga hides her minions too: wait for them to strike.
tutorial.cloak.cloak: Cloak: can't be attacked until it attacks
tutorial.powers.title: Champion Powers
tutorial.powers.text: Every champion has a Champion Power. It costs Mana and can be used once each turn. Iris's Siphon picks off weak minions and draws a card.
tutorial.powers.siphon: Iris Null: 1 damage to a minion, a card if it dies
tutorial.powers.shakedown: Mother Rust: 2 damage to the enemy champion and 1 Plating
tutorial.powers.deploy: Director Vale: a 0/2 Drone with Firewall
tutorial.chain.title: Chain
tutorial.chain.text: Chain gives a bonus if you already played a card this turn. Play a cheap card first, then the Chain card.
tutorial.wipe.title: Wipe and Glitch
tutorial.wipe.text: Wipe removes all text from a minion: its Firewall, its effects, its buffs. Corrupt rewrites a minion into a harmless Glitch.
tutorial.wipe.wipe: Wipe: the minion loses all its text, Firewall too
tutorial.protocol.title: Protocols
tutorial.protocol.text: A Protocol is a hidden spell. It waits face down and triggers on the opponent's turn. Director Vale has three of them!
tutorial.protocol.when: When you play a minion, it is hit and Jammed
tutorial.shields.title: Hardlight and Encrypted
tutorial.shields.text: Hardlight stops the first damage, so break it with something small. Encrypted minions can't be targeted by spells or Champion Powers: fight them with minions.
tutorial.shields.hardlight: Hardlight: the first damage does nothing
tutorial.shields.encrypted: Encrypted: spells and powers can't target it
tutorial.all_together.title: Putting it all together
tutorial.all_together.text: Director Vale plays the real Hostile Merger deck. Use everything you have learned: trade with his minions and hit Vale with Shakedown every turn.
tutorial.all_together.deploy: His power: a Firewall Drone every turn
tutorial.all_together.archon: ARCHON: answer it at once, or the wall grows
tutorial.all_together.shakedown: Shakedown ignores Firewall: hit Vale every turn
